data.title: Indian Mackerel — Arabian Sea exceeding sustainable catch rate by 14%
data.protocol: INCOIS PFZ Advisory — Vessel limit enforced in sectors 7–9
data.detail: Oil Sardine and Indian Mackerel TAC 82% consumed with 6 weeks remaining in season. Precautionary quota freeze in effect. Ref: CMFRI Bulletin WK-11-2026.

data.title: Bay of Bengal trawl ban in effect — pre-monsoon closure period approaching
data.protocol: DoF Circular No. F.No.11013/12/2024-Fy (3) — April 15 ban commencement
data.detail: East Coast monsoon trawl ban commences April 15, 2026. All mechanised trawlers must vacate 0–200 NM EEZ. Traditional craft within 5 NM exempted.

data.title: Oil Sardine quota 82% consumed — North Kerala zone monitor
data.protocol: CMFRI Alert Level 1 — Increased monitoring deployed
data.detail: Oil Sardine catch in North Kerala at 82% TAC. Cap expected by April 2 if pace continues. CMFRI recommends 20% reduction in directed effort.

data.title: Cyclone advisory: Tamil Nadu coast — all fishing vessels recalled
data.protocol: IMD Cyclone Warning Stage 1 — All vessels within 100 km of coast recalled
data.detail: IMD depression advisory over SW Bay of Bengal. Wind speeds 45–55 kmph. All vessels advised to return to harbour immediately.
